title: Cherrypicking Protocol for Opentrons
author: Opentrons
materials: Create your CSV file according to our instructions.

steps.title: Prepare CSV file
steps.instruction: Create a comma‑separated values (.csv) file that includes a header row followed by rows specifying source well, destination well, and transfer volume in microliters (μL). In the same file, list each labware’s loadname and deck slot as required. If a mid‑run pause is needed to replenish plates, insert a line that reads `pause` at the appropriate point. Save the file with a .csv extension.

substeps.instruction: Enter rows with source well, destination well, and volume (μL).
Include labware loadname and slot columns as described in the app.
Insert `pause` lines where you want the robot to stop.

steps.title: Upload CSV and set parameters
steps.instruction: Open the Opentrons OT‑2 Run App (Version 3.15.0 or later), upload the prepared CSV file, and select all desired settings such as pipette type and tip‑rack type. The app will automatically load labware based on the CSV entries and fill any empty deck slots with the necessary tip racks, prompting you to refill them if they run out.

substeps.instruction: Click “Upload CSV” and select your file.
Choose the single‑channel pipette and compatible tip rack.
Confirm that labware loadnames and slots are recognized.

steps.title: Download generated protocol
steps.instruction: Click the blue “Download” button located above the deck map to download the customized Python protocol script that will run on the OT‑2.

steps.title: Prepare source plates with samples
steps.instruction: Add the samples you wish to cherry‑pick into the appropriate wells of the source plate(s) as indicated in the CSV file. Ensure plates are sealed or covered as needed before placing them on the robot deck.

steps.title: Load protocol and run robot
steps.instruction: In the Opentrons App, upload the downloaded protocol script, follow the prompts to set up the deck layout, calibrate all labware, and start the run. When a `pause` command appears, replenish tip racks or replace source plates as instructed, then resume the protocol.

substeps.instruction: Arrange deck according to the displayed layout.
Start the run and respond to any pause prompts.
